description: PAID $0.03 (x402, USDC on Base or Solana). Rule-based long/short/watch/avoid verdict for one trade.xyz stock perp, using the perp-vs-stock gap, basis, funding and SEC EDGAR insider and filing signals, with reasons and confidence. Includes a news block (up to 5 items in 48h: SEC 8-K filings, Fed/BLS macro releases, press-wire items as our own one-line summary + link) and a heuristic news_context label (likely news-driven / news present, move small / possibly macro-driven / no matching news). Data, not financial advice.
name: get_verdict
